values: Add Book allows the user to register a new PDF document using one explicitly selected source method. Radio buttons switch between Local Upload and Fetch from URL; only the controls belonging to the selected method are enabled and only that source is submitted. The user then enters metadata, validates the form and creates a new Book record.
Revised SCR-06 design and detailed enabled/disabled states for the source-method radio controls.
Overview of source selection, validation, submission and navigation behavior.
Display a Back to Library action above the page title.
Returns without creating a Book record.
Use Add Book or Add Document consistently across UI and documents.
Select Local Upload as the active source method.
Selected by default. Only one source-method radio may be selected.
Open the device file picker and display the selected PDF file name.
Enabled only when Local Upload is selected; disabled styling follows the state specification.
Select Fetch from URL as the active source method.
Selecting it disables Browse and enables the URL input.
Allow entry of an HTTP/HTTPS PDF URL.
Enabled only when Fetch from URL is selected.
Visually communicate that the source methods are mutually exclusive.
Radio buttons provide the actual selection behavior.
Required text input for the document title.
Required text input for the author.
Valid range should be defined; recommended 1 through current year.
Optional multi-value tag input; Enter creates a tag chip.
Trim values, prevent duplicates and support removing a chip.
Recommended maximum 2,000 characters with a counter if enforced.
Submit the selected source and metadata.
Disable while submitting to prevent duplicate records.
Discard the current operation and return to Library.
Prompt for confirmation when unsaved data exists.
Display Dashboard, Library, Recent and Favorites; highlight Library.
Only one navigation item is active.
Display the Settings icon according to the common header specification.
Hide or disable if Settings is outside scope.
Display application version and current Online/Offline mode.
Remote URL validation and submission require Online mode.
Initialize an empty form with Local Upload selected, Browse enabled and Remote URL input disabled.
The default selected radio determines the pending sourceType.
When Browse is selected, open the file picker; after selection, validate the PDF and display its file name.
Accept one .pdf file only; validate MIME type, extension and size.
Reject unsupported, empty, corrupted or oversized files and display an inline error.
Maximum file size must be configurable; suggested learning-project limit: 50 MB.
When Browse is enabled, allow the selected PDF to be replaced and update the displayed file name.
Replacing does not create or delete a Book record.
Set pending sourceType = LOCAL_UPLOAD, enable Browse and disable the Remote URL input.
A previously entered URL may remain visible but disabled; it is not submitted.
Set pending sourceType = REMOTE_URL, disable Browse and enable the Remote URL input.
A previously selected file name may remain visible but disabled; the file is not uploaded.
Validate that the URL uses HTTP or HTTPS and is syntactically valid.
Reject unsupported protocols and whitespace-only input.
Verify that the remote resource is accessible and represents a PDF.
Handle redirects, timeout, HTTP errors and content-type mismatch. Browser CORS limitations may require backend validation.
Disable remote validation/submission and explain that an online connection is required.
Local Upload remains available if the application can receive the file.
Pressing Enter with a non-empty tag creates a chip; selecting its remove icon deletes it.
Do not submit the form merely because Enter is used in the tag field.
On submit, validate only the currently selected source method together with required Title and Author.
Ignore the disabled source control even if it retains a previous value; focus the first error.
If entered, require an integer within the allowed range.
Do not accept decimals or non-numeric characters.
If Local Upload is selected, upload only the selected PDF and create the Book record with sourceType = LOCAL_UPLOAD.
Do not submit a disabled URL value. Store originalFileName, fileSize and application filePath.
If Fetch from URL is selected, create the Book record with sourceType = REMOTE_URL and pdfUrl after validation.
Do not upload a retained disabled local file or automatically save the remote PDF to IndexedDB.
Initialize favorite = false, lastReadPage = 0, readingStatus = UNREAD and timestamps.
totalPages may be extracted during validation/upload or populated after first PDF load.
Show a success message and navigate to SCR-02 Library or open MD-01 for the created Book.
Recommended simple flow: return to Library and highlight the new record.
Keep entered metadata, show an error and allow Retry.
Clean up an uploaded application file if Book creation fails after file storage.
Prevent repeated submission while the request is running.
Use server-side protection in addition to disabling the button.
Return to Library immediately when the form is empty.
When form data exists, ask the user to confirm discarding it.
Canceling the confirmation returns to the form with all data retained.
Stack source and metadata sections vertically and keep actions reachable without horizontal scrolling.
File drop may become a standard file picker on mobile.
Associate labels and errors with inputs, expose required state and support keyboard file selection.
Do not communicate validation only by color.
